title: Email Marketing Tools Pricing Guide 2026: Mailchimp vs Klaviyo vs ActiveCampaign vs Kit

facts.fact: The page states that email marketing pricing starts at $20/month and can reach $500–2,000/month as a subscriber list grows.
facts.quote: what starts at $20/month can hit $500–2,000/month as your list grows

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp raised prices significantly in 2022 and restricted its free plan to 500 contacts, down from 2,000.
facts.quote: The company raised prices significantly in 2022 and restricted the free plan to 500 contacts — down from 2,000 previously.

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp's 2024 price increase raised paid plan prices by 30–45%.
facts.quote: raising paid plan prices 30–45%

facts.fact: The page lists the Mailchimp Essentials plan at $13/month for 1K contacts.
facts.quote: | Essentials | $13/mo | $52/mo | $230/mo | Unlimited sends, A/B testing, custom branding |

facts.fact: The page lists the Mailchimp Standard plan at $20/month for 1K contacts.
facts.quote: | Standard | $20/mo | $75/mo | $270/mo | Customer journeys, send-time optimization, retargeting ads |

facts.fact: The page states that Mailchimp's Premium plan starts at $350+/month.
facts.quote: | Premium | $350+/mo | $350+/mo | $350+/mo | Advanced segmentation, unlimited seats, phone support |

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp's Mandrill transactional email add-on starts at $20/month for 500K emails.
facts.quote: Starts at $20/mo for 500K emails.

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp counts a contact in two audiences as two contacts for billing.
facts.quote: A contact in 2 audiences counts as 2 contacts.

facts.fact: The page lists Klaviyo's free tier as 250 contacts with 150 SMS credits.
facts.quote: | Free (250 contacts) | $0 | $0 (150 SMS credits) |

facts.fact: The page lists Klaviyo's email-only plan for 1,001–1,500 contacts at $30/month.
The page lists Klaviyo's email-only plan for 50,001–60,000 contacts at $700/month.
The page states Klaviyo charges $0.01 per outbound SMS, plus carrier fees.
facts.quote: Klaviyo charges separately for SMS: $0.01/SMS for outbound, $0.01/MMS (multimedia), plus carrier fees.

facts.fact: The page says Klaviyo's Reviews add-on costs $25–$100+/month depending on orders.
facts.quote: Reviews add-on: Product reviews collection requires a separate Reviews module ($25–$100+/mo depending on orders).

facts.fact: The page says Klaviyo counts subscribed, unsubscribed, and suppressed profiles toward its billing tier.
facts.quote: Klaviyo counts all profiles (subscribed, unsubscribed, suppressed) toward your billing tier.

facts.fact: The page lists ActiveCampaign's Starter plan at $15/month for 500 contacts.

facts.fact: The page lists ActiveCampaign's Professional plan at $79/month for 500 contacts.
facts.quote: | Professional | $79/mo | $169/mo | $369/mo | Predictive sending, site messaging, 5 users |

facts.fact: Beehiiv's ad network pays publishers per send at typical CPMs of $1–$3, with no cost to publishers, per the page.
facts.quote: pays you per send (CPMs typically $1–$3). No cost to publishers.

facts.fact: Beehiiv takes 5% of paid subscription revenue, with the share declining at higher plan levels.
facts.quote: Beehiiv takes 5% of subscription revenue (declining with plan level).

facts.fact: Beehiiv Boosts typically cost $1.50–$3 per new verified subscriber, depending on spend.
facts.quote: Typically $1.50–$3 per new verified subscriber. Cost depends on your spend.

facts.fact: At a 50K-subscriber list, the page lists Beehiiv Grow at $99/month and Mailchimp Standard at $350+/month.
facts.unit: USD per month (Beehiiv Grow); Mailchimp Standard $350+/month
facts.quote: Beehiiv Grow: **$99/month.** Mailchimp Standard: **$350+/month.**

facts.fact: Brevo's Starter plan costs $25/month for 20,000 emails per month, per the page's pricing table.
facts.quote: Starter | 20,000/mo | $25/mo

facts.fact: Brevo's Business plan costs $65/month for 60,000 emails per month, per the page's pricing table.
facts.quote: Business | 60,000/mo | $65/mo

facts.fact: The page's estimate for a 50K list sending one 50,000-email newsletter per month is $65/month on Brevo versus $350–700/month on Mailchimp or Klaviyo.
facts.unit: USD per month (Brevo); Mailchimp or Klaviyo $350–700/month
facts.quote: A 50K subscriber list sending one monthly newsletter (50,000 emails) costs **$65/month on Brevo** vs. $350–700/month on Mailchimp or Klaviyo.

facts.fact: Mailchimp cut its free plan from 2,000 to 500 contacts in 2022, without grandfathering existing users, according to the page.
facts.quote: Mailchimp cut their free plan from 2,000 to 500 contacts in 2022 without grandfathering existing users.

facts.fact: Mailchimp raised prices 30–45% on its Essentials and Standard plans during 2022–2024, per the page.
facts.quote: [Raised prices 30–45%](https://www.getpricepulse.com/blog/mailchimp-price-increase-2024.html) on Essentials and Standard plans.

facts.fact: Klaviyo reduced its free plan to 250 contacts in 2024, down from 500 previously, per the page.
facts.quote: Free plan reduced to 250 contacts (from 500 previously).

facts.fact: The page says some long-term ActiveCampaign customers saw 20% increases at renewal following its 2023 pricing changes.
facts.quote: Some long-term customers saw 20% increases at renewal.

facts.fact: Kit's free plan covers up to 10,000 subscribers, according to the page, though Creator Pro pricing rose for higher contact tiers in 2024.
facts.quote: Free plan remains very generous at 10,000 subscribers, but Creator Pro pricing increased for higher contact tiers.

facts.fact: The page claims migrating from HubSpot Marketing to ActiveCampaign can reduce costs by 60–80%; this is the page's own claim, not a verified figure.
facts.quote: You're migrating from HubSpot Marketing to reduce costs by 60–80%
